title: PDF Watermark Missing on Some Pages? Check the Export
description: If a PDF watermark is missing on some pages, inspect the exported marked copy outside the app and check every page.
direct: Open the exported PDF and compare it with the source page by page. Check whether the mark is absent from the actual file or only from one viewer’s preview.

cards.choice.heading: Find the right copy
cards.choice.body: Keep the original and marked output clearly named. Confirm that you opened the newly exported file rather than the untouched source or an older attachment. Check a portrait page, a landscape page and any unusually large sheet.
sections.explain.heading: Diagnose without guessing
sections.explain.body: If a mark is visible in one viewer but absent in another, retain both observations and test the exact recipient workflow. Avoid claiming that every viewer handles layers or page geometry identically. For a printed deliverable, examine a proof as well. Do not send a known incomplete copy.
sections.practice.heading: Keep the boundary clear
sections.practice.body: Its current listing supports repeated diagonal watermarks across every page, centered marks and page previews. This guide describes checking a newly marked copy; it does not promise to repair every third-party watermark or explain an untested file’s precise defect. Watermarks label documents and do not remove private information, enforce permissions or prevent copying.
faqs.reader-question-1.heading: The watermark is in the preview but missing from the saved copy. What should I check first?
faqs.reader-question-1.body: Confirm the filename and save location so you are opening the newly exported PDF. Then check the affected page in another viewer.
faqs.reader-question-2.heading: What if the mark is missing in both viewers?
faqs.reader-question-2.body: Keep the source and saved copy. Try a fresh export from the original, and keep the affected page numbers if you need support.

steps.step-1.text: Open the document in PDF Watermark & Stamp and choose repeated diagonal text or a large centered mark. Export tools require Pro.
steps.step-2.text: Preview all pages. Adjust size, opacity and color so the mark remains visible without obscuring the document.
steps.step-3.text: Export a new copy, open it in another PDF viewer and inspect the beginning, middle and end, including every different page size.
